Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
I have seen that Obedience's text has "slightly" changed:

Name: Obedience
[Jyhad, V:TES, Sabbat, SW, CE]
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Dominate
Only usable when this reacting vampire is about to enter combat with an
acting younger vampire.
[dom] Untap the acting vampire, do not tap this reacting vampire, and
end the current action (and combat). The acting vampire cannot attempt
the same action this turn.
[DOM] As above, but do not untap the acting vampire.

The sentence "and end the current action (and combat)" is what puzzles
me.

Does "ending combat" mean that there has been some kind of combat (which
would allow playing a Hidden Lurker afterwards)?

Greetings,
Damnans
